Compute PnL for a single bet

Source: R/backtest_oagd.R
oagd_pnl.Rd

Compute PnL for a single bet

Usage

oagd_pnl(stake, odds, won, transaction_cost = 0, slippage = 0)

Arguments

stake

Integer. Units staked (0, 1, or 2).

odds

Numeric. Decimal odds for the outcome bet on.

won

Logical. Whether the outcome occurred.

transaction_cost

Numeric. Proportional cost on stake (default 0, e.g. 0.02 = 2% commission).

slippage

Numeric. Proportional reduction in effective odds (default 0, e.g. 0.01 = 1% worse than quoted).

Value

Numeric. Profit/loss after costs.
